value.description: Day of Week builds intelligence infrastructure for local food systems, helping hotels, restaurants, chefs and farmers create, sell and scale local food experiences.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Better outcomes for every link in the local food chain
Day of Week connect market insight, brand, local supply, food concepts, menues and customer engagement into one AI-powered system that delivers measurable results.
From market insight and strategy to sales
Turn global demand into local value.
Connects real market insight with local food, seasons and specialist knowledge, helping you identify who to attract, when to attract them, and what experiences actually drive demand beyond peak season.
Menues with real stories
Stronger guest attraction, differentation and year-round relevance.
Food concepts and menus are powered by real-time data, nutrition and tracking turning food into stories guests understand, value and return for.
Predictable local supply
Less risk. Better margins.
Closed-loop operations connect local farmers capacity with real kitchen demand reducing guesswork, securing availability and making local sourcing reliable at scale.
Explore how we partner with you to design, build and scale unique food experiences.
Designer for hospitality | Creator for farmers

pages.title: Who We Are | Day of Week
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Established in 2021
The Day of Week origin
In 2021, we travelled farm to farm across Norway to understand the real challenges facing local farmers and professional kitchens. What we discovered was not a lack of quality, but a lack of connection, structure and scalable systems. Day of Week was founded to bridge that gap, and transform food into local food experiences.
Our Mission & Vision
Our mission is to accelerate and scale local food systems through continuous innovation — for farmers, hospitality and the world’s food-curious.
Our vision is to make local food the engine of the global food economy.
We believe that when local food becomes structured, measurable and connected through technology, it moves from being a passion to becoming power — driving sustainable growth, stronger producers and next-generation food experiences across markets.
Engage in the vision →

pages.title: News | Day of Week
pages.main_text_excerpt:
From grain field to guest experience: NRK highlights Day of Week's work on short local value chains
NRK follows the grain from Øvre Åbål Gård in Birkenes to the kitchen at Under. The story shows the potential in collaboration between producers, chefs, tourism and market — and the need for better systems around and between them.
Read the story →
News
More stories
Rogaland: Norway's emerging innovation hub for food and technology
From fertile farmland and coastal food traditions to world-class innovation environments, Rogaland is where food culture and technology meet to shape the future of food systems.
Scaling Authenticity: Why We Built Day of Week to Transform the Global Food System
Øystein Løken, Co-Founder & CSO, on why Day of Week was built to harness technology for systemic change. Scaling local, high-quality food globally.
Local Food. Global Engine.
We believe local food is one of the most underutilized economic forces in the world. Here is how Day of Week is building the operating system for local food systems.
CAIO Portrait: Øyvind Brekkhus Sandåker on building AI for food systems
Meet our Chief AI Officer — the architect behind Day of Week's AI strategy and the systems that power everything from ChefAI profiles to platform intelligence.
From grain and stone milling to baking, insight and well-being
What happens when grain is treated not just as a raw material, but as flavour, culture and long-term value? Together with Øvre Åbål Gård, local bakers and a stone mill on the farm, we explored how grain can shape food experiences across different needs, from professional bakers performance, to consumers looking for well-being, quality and taste. Connecting insight with market execution.
Norway as Female Tech Founder Frontrunner: Siv Kristiansen
Day of Week is selected for the first 2026 cohort of a national growth program supported by Innovation Norway, representing 15 Norwegian tech companies with female founders.
NORCE Research: building location-aware AI for local food systems
Together with NORCE we proved that a location-based AI model can suggest practical, season-aware menus matched to local producer supply, a milestone toward unlocking local sourcing.
